children.description:
OCPI 2.3.0 is published as a core specification plus functional modules that are packaged and released independently: each module package bundles a core edition with one module.
Besides the modules, the core defines the protocol meta information that connects the parties: transport and format, status codes, the version information endpoint and credentials & registration.
Core functional modules:
Additional modules (packaged separately). Payments and Bookings are optional and evolve independently of the core: each carries its own module version, and each PDF bundles it with one core edition. They are independent from each other and from Invoice Reconciliation — an implementation may support any of them on its own. The upstream compatibility matrix maps every document to its tag, branch, core edition and module version. Its release status lags behind: it still marks Edition 2 and Edition 2 Payments as planned and says the 2.3.0 tags are not GitHub Releases, while the PDFs linked here are published as releases.

items.description:
The Open Charge Point Interface (OCPI) is a protocol for roaming between charging station networks. The next version is developed in the repository, which only EVRoaming Foundation contributors can access. OCPI 3.0 is not released yet: according to the OCPI downloads page, it awaits official review by CENELEC, with a release expected in H2 2027.
OCPI versions read . A suffix (, ) marks a documentation update of the same specification: text and examples only, no protocol change. From 2.3.0 on, the core is also published in editions (, ), where an edition may change messages, fields or datatypes. This edition scheme follows a CEN-CENELEC proposal that is still under discussion.
